t: Digital Sovereignty & Future-Proofing: The Grammar of Git and NixOS
s: This entry explores how foundational command-line skills, particularly Git's distributed nature and the concept of a bare repository for local backups, enable self-determination and digital sovereignty, emphasizing the enduring 'grammar of intent' over specific tools.
sub: Establishing private development environments with Git
Implementing a local bare Git repository for data resilience
Understanding the 'grammar of intent' as a future-proofing concept
Leveraging NixOS for reproducible, portable backup strategies
